description: AgMIP-Wheat collaborators published multi-model ensemble outputs for 60 representative locations worldwide under climate change and adaptation scenarios. The Zenodo deposit identifies modelling protocols and underlying studies on wheat protein and warming levels. It is model output, not measured yield observations. The named public Zenodo page opened and DataCite lists text files and CC BY 4.0, with no price indicated. Food-supply modellers can compare crop-model responses across locations and adaptation choices or reproduce scenario analysis where protocol details are sufficient. The 60 sites are representative cases, not an exhaustive gridded global yield map. The exact scenario years, variables and model membership were not verified from the files because no payload was downloaded. The deposit is related to the field-observation AgMIP wheat benchmarks in G4-0566, G4-0571 and G4-0575, but it is a separate climate-scenario output collection. A full local duplicate scan found no catalogue identity match.
